title: Determination of AMBER Force Field Parameters for Thioester by Quantum Chemical Calculations
authors: Akifumi Oda, Shuichi Fukuyoshi, Ryoichi Nakagaki, Ohgi Takahashi
why: THE target paper. Derives AMBER parameters specifically 'around the sulfur atom of the thioester moiety' by high-accuracy QM, and computes atomic charges for ACETYLCYSTEINE - which is exactly our chemistry (an acyl group on a Cys sulfur). Validated on short peptides containing acetylcysteine, QM vs MM. This would REPLACE my GAFF2-to-protein-type transfer with published protein-atom-type values.
need: Table of bond/angle/dihedral terms around S, plus the acetylcysteine charges.

title: Parameterization of Palmitoylated Cysteine, Farnesylated Cysteine, Geranylgeranylated Cysteine, and Multiple Lipidated Cysteines with the Martini Force Field / all-atom counterparts
journal: The Journal of Physical Chemistry B
why: S-palmitoylation IS a cysteine thioester, so the palmitoyl-Cys residue is our linkage with a lipid tail instead of ubiquitin. Highly cited, so its parameters are the de facto community standard for acylated cysteine. NOTE: the paper's headline is Martini (coarse-grained), which we CANNOT use directly - I need to see whether it also reports the all-atom reference parameters it was mapped from, which such papers usually do.
need: Any all-atom (CHARMM36 or AMBER) palmitoyl-Cys parameters and the S-C(=O) terms.

title: Development of a Pantetheine Force Field Library for Molecular Modeling
authors: Shiji Zhao, Andrew J. Schaub, Shiou-Chuan Tsai, Ray Luo
journal: Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling
why: Independent validation of our exact approach. Builds acyl-CoA/phosphopantetheine THIOESTER parameters on gaff2 + ff14SB, and validates an 'acetyl cysteamine fragment ... as a representative thioester extending unit' against MP2/aug-cc-pVDZ QM - reproducing the C-S stretch at 645/749 cm-1, O-C-S bend at 439 cm-1 and the thioester carbonyl at 1720 cm-1. That is published evidence that GAFF2 describes a thioester correctly.
need: Nothing - already read. Supplementary frcmod files would still be useful.

title: Robust AMBER Force Field Parameters for Glutathionylated Cysteines
why: METHODOLOGY template, not our chemistry: glutathionylation is a DISULFIDE (S-S), not a thioester (C-S). Useful as a worked example of parameterising a modified cysteine for AMBER and validating it against experiment over 33 us of MD - i.e. the standard we should hold ourselves to. Do NOT transfer its numbers.

title: Capturing the catalytic intermediates of parkin ubiquitination
authors: (Gladkova/Trempe-adjacent group; full list in the PDF)
why: Closest published precedent to what we want, and instructive about what the field actually does. They model the E2~Ub / E3~Ub transthiolation intermediate, but they do NOT parameterise a thioester: the covalent linkage is imposed as a SINGLE UNAMBIGUOUS DISTANCE RESTRAINT in HADDOCK, and the MD is plain AMBER99SB with no custom residue. So the leading structural paper on exactly our intermediate sidesteps the parameter problem entirely.
need: Nothing - already read. Cited as precedent for the restrained alternative.
